title: Must Do!
text: Lots of walking through three neighborhoods and a park. All worth it for the street art and the views into the city. Michael was knowledgeable about the local artists and the history of the neighborhoods. Highly recommend this one.
author: Laurie_C

title: Beautiful Granada!
text:
A very rewarding walk with a very nice and knowledgeable guide, Michael.
Highly recommended.
author: ial2025

title: Fascinating
text: A fascinating look at some of the less touristy areas of Granada. Our guide, Michael, was incredibly knowledgeable. We had a great time and would definitely recommend
author: 64alisont

title: Fun street art tour
text: I really enjoyed this tour. The guide is friendly and lively and has expert knowledge of the local street art scene. He will drop many gems along the way and has a cool musical taste. He has great knowledge of the city and will give excellent insight and recommendations.
author: sahrk2016
